data.one_liner: Provides a section list view widget with alphabet indexer and refresh support.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display grouped list data with section headers, alphabet indexes, and customizable refresh controls. It supports sticky headers and fully custom builders for items, headers, and alphabets.
use_when: You need to display a contact-list style view grouped by alphabetic sections.
You want section headers that stick while scrolling through grouped data.
avoid_when: You do not need sectioned data or alphabet navigation.
You are looking for a state-management or networking solution.
strengths: Provides sticky header functionality via flutter_list_view
weaknesses: Tailer load-more functionality is listed as a Todo and is not provided natively
Limited built-in categories and documentation for complex use cases
data.minimal_example:
SectionView<GroupModel, ItemModel>(
  source: data,
  onFetchListData: (header) => header.items,
  headerBuilder: getDefaultHeaderBuilder((d) => d.name,
      bkColor: Colors.green,
      style:
          const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Colors.white)),
  itemBuilder:
      (context, itemData, itemIndex, headerData, headerIndex) =>
          ListTile(
            title: Text(itemData.name),
          ))
